cases.question: What information do we have about sequencing and call quality?

Sequencing (sample-level) — world_cup.genomics.samples
- assay: Sequencing assay type (e.g., WGS, WES, PANEL).
- tissue: Tissue/source of the sample (e.g., BLOOD, SALIVA, BUCCAL, TUMOR).

- collected_on: Sample collection date.

- is_control: Flag indicating QC/control material (vs cohort samples).

- sample_code
- assay
- mean_coverage
- is_control
- pass_call_count: Number of variant calls that passed filtering for the sample.
- non_reference_call_count: Number of calls where the genotype is not 0/0 (i.e., carrier calls 0/1 or 1/1).

Call quality (per-variant per-sample) — world_cup.genomics.variant_calls
- genotype: 0/0, 0/1, or 1/1.
- filter_status: PASS or LOW_QUAL to indicate call quality status.
- genotype_quality: Numeric quality score for the genotype call.
- alt_read_count and total_read_count: Read support for the alternate allele and total reads at the site (read_depth duplicates total_read_count in this data).
- sample_id and variant_id: Keys to join calls to their sample and variant.

Call details with names (convenience view) — world_cup.genomics.v_variant_calls
- sample_code and subject_code: Human-readable identifiers.
- gene_symbol, chromosome, position, reference_allele, alternate_allele: Locus and gene context.
- clinical_significance: Variant classification (e.g., PATHOGENIC, BENIGN, VUS).
- genotype, alt_read_count, total_read_count, filter_status: Same call-quality fields as above, exposed alongside the gene/locus.

These entities together let you:
- Describe sequencing setup and depth per sample (assay, instrument, mean coverage).
- Assess call quality per site in each sample (PASS vs LOW_QUAL, genotype quality).

Sequencing (per sample)

  - pass_call_count (number of calls with filter_status = 'PASS')
  - non_reference_call_count (number of 0/1 or 1/1 genotype calls)

Variant call quality (per call)
- world_cup.genomics.variant_calls
  - genotype (0/0, 0/1, 1/1; 0/1 and 1/1 are carriers)
  - filter_status (PASS or LOW_QUAL; “high-confidence” means PASS)
  - alt_read_count and total_read_count (read counts supporting alt and total reads; read_depth duplicates total_read_count in this dataset)
  - genotype_quality (integer quality score for the genotype)
- world_cup.genomics.v_variant_calls (call-level with annotations)

Governed quality metrics available
- High-confidence call rate: share of calls with filter_status = 'PASS'
- Allele fraction: average alt_read_count / total_read_count across PASS calls with at least 20 total reads
